meta.title: What if the task is the prayer? | The Hundredth Task
meta.description:
The Hundredth Task is a gentle marimba and kalimba song with a warm female voice, about finding prayer inside ordinary work rather than after it. It ends in a long quiet tail where you are allowed to rest.

A hymn for the work that repeats, after Brother Lawrence, the cook who found the time of work and the time of prayer to be one hour.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/the-hundredth-task

0:00 I
0:52 II
1:37 III

a Church AI + Human: a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#Meditation #Mindfulness #Prayer

copy.hook: A cook in a crowded kitchen found that the work was the prayer. What changes if the hundredth task is as holy as the first?
copy.headline: What if the task is the prayer?
copy.lead: The Hundredth Task is a gentle marimba and kalimba song with a warm female voice, about finding prayer inside ordinary work rather than after it. It ends in a long quiet tail where you are allowed to rest.
copy.alt: Glowing amber embers and a brimming golden vessel send braided ribbons of steam through indigo dark. A corridor of identical beads then recedes to one white-gold bloom, and a small rosette of light rests above still water.
